situation (example wording): "Carjackings in Tennessee by year from 2021 to 2025, only agencies that reported every month": the Consistent Reporting Agencies view's sentence
what the app does today: "This counts only the N Consistent Reporting Agencies that reported every month."
proposed behavior: "This counts only the N Consistent Reporting Agencies, covering roughly P people, that reported every month from START through END." P is the sum of each Consistent Reporting Agency's current population: its most recent FBI population in the build, whatever the answer's span. Rounded to two significant figures, millions in words ("4.1 million", "12 million", "850,000"); "at least P" when an agency has no population.
exact default or choices offered: Current population, rounded; "at least" when any is missing.
why: A reader wants to know how much of the place the consistent view stands for.
status: Decided 2026-11-02 (Jeff: "covering roughly TK people"; "population should be sum of current population of consistent agencies")
